messages:
marta: quick thread — iterating the competitive battlecard for the 'real costs of LLM serving' webinar next week. want lean rebuttals vs cloud AI, LLM APIs, infra vendors. can we do 10 lines max per competitor group?
kevin: yes. prioritize stuff sales can say verbatim. short bullets, no long essays. also want 1-sentence customer proof per pillar. :thumbsup:
anita: agree. my suggested pillars: 1) performance economics (per-token and end-to-end tail latency), 2) predictable capacity & SLAs (dedicated + private), 3) ops/observability (traces, token-level cost).
samir: inbound routing ask: any lead that mentions "SLA", "private deployment", or "on-prem" should be routed to enterprise AEs immediately. also flag accounts > $50k ARR.
jules: got it. do we want a routing snippet so support/devops can plug into the lead webhook?
kevin: yes paste small YAML for engineering to implement — simple keyword mapping is fine.
samir: here's a minimal rule that should be safe to deploy:```match:  - keywords: ["SLA","private","on-prem","VPC","enterprise"]    route: enterprise_aes  - keywords: ["prototype","hack","free","startup"]    route: self_serve_growth  - keywords: ["latency","tail","p99","throughput"]    route: infra/solutions```
anita: perfect. for battlecard copy: short headline + 2-sentence proof + one-liner rebuttal vs typical vendor claim. example for cloud AI platforms:
kevin: claim: "we're easiest and cheapest — just use managed endpoints."
anita: rebuttal headline: "Lower list price ≠ lower unit cost at scale." proof: "Our batching, KV caching and model selection reduce per-token cost by 30-60% vs generic managed endpoints on real chats (customer benchmark)." one-liner rebuttal: "Managed endpoints hide tail latency and cross-tenant noisy neighbor costs — we optimize for predictable per-request economics."
marta: love that. make sure we include a short script for sales: a 2-line opening + 1 follow-up question.
jules: sales script example: "We're focused on predictable inference economics — how important is consistent p99 latency for your product?" follow-up: "Would you prefer a reserved pool with SLA or a burstable hosted option?"
kevin: need a callout for infra vendors (self-hosted runtimes) — angle: "we give ops-ready runtime + orchestration without building" proof: "turnkey dedicated/private offering with observability and automated rollouts." rebuttal: "If you already built an internal runtime, ask about maintenance burden and upgrades."
anita: also add a benchmark narrative for the webinar: not just raw throughput numbers — show unit-cost curves across load patterns, and a short case study: "7x throughput improvement via batching, 40% token cost reduction after quantization + routing".
samir: Ops note: include a small checklist for evaluating vendors during qualifying call — items: SLA, KV cache support, routing/fallback policies, quantization compatibility, rollout controls, audit logs.
marta: good. @dev-bot can you create a draft GDoc and add these sections? put it under Marketing > Webinar assets and tag me + kevin + anita.
dev-bot: created doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EXAMPLE - title: "Webinar: Real Costs of LLM Serving — Battlecard + Routing". Editors: marta, kevin, anita.
jules: timeline check — we need final battlecard by Mon EOD so sales can rehearse Wed. webinar dry run Thurs.
marta: schedule looks right. who's owning the competitor one-liners? kevin and anita?
kevin: i'll do cloud AI platforms + LLM API messaging. anita will take infra vendors + dedicated/private angle. jules will own inbound routing implementation. samir will create the AE flag rules in the CRM.
anita: i'll mock up the 1-pagers (3 pillars) tonight and drop in the doc.
marta: tiny ask — include 2 quick objection-handlers per pillar, and 1 customer-number (percent or multiple) where possible. sales loves metrics.
samir: CRM rule: flag lead if company_size > 200 OR annual_spend_estimate > 50000. routing rule above + set priority=high. I'll add to the doc.
kevin: one more: webinar hook copy for landing page — "Stop guessing inference cost. See how ops + smart routing cut per-token spend and tame tail latency."
jules: will wire the landing page with registration. need a hero 2-line blurb and one graphic idea (cost curve).
marta: this is good — last step: can everyone drop final bullets in the doc by Mon 9am PT? then I'll synthesize into the slide deck.
kevin: done.
anita: will do.
end of thread.
